title: Fortune publishes Incorruptible excerpt: 'I wrote the playbook that built Big Tech. I misjudged what would happen next'
summary: Fortune runs a launch-day book excerpt under Eric's byline — opening with The Professor, the founder whose AI could either heal or kill, who calls Eric on the way to a wake disguised as a celebration.
blockquote:
It was happening again.

The Professor's voice had an intensity—and fear—that was impossible to ignore.
